verification.scope: Executed catalog assembly, consumer, and impact tests over independent fixtures. Case verification is separate from the complete product workflow.
verification.statusMeaning: Verified means that the test exercised the behavior and observed the expected decision and diagnostic. An expected failed or incomplete decision is a verified negative case.
verification.standards: RDFLib parses exported DCAT graphs. The pinned OpenLineage schemas validate exported events and version facets. A local independent receiver checks OpenLineage identity and replay.

unsupportedCapabilities.reason: The shared relationship checker preserves project rule references and reports unknown when evaluation is required. CASE-CATALOG-029 verifies that boundary.
The public view supports catalog and DCAT disclosure. The OpenLineage exporter currently runs for local catalogs.
The bounded DocSpec receipt attests registered versions and native outputs. It does not establish actual input scans or full consumption coverage.

cases.evidence: Assembles two owner occurrences with one content digest and verifies the selected ODCS object and its original document digest.
Rejects contradictory retention observations for one exact version and scope and cites both owner records.
Resolves three ODPS ports to separate objects in the same pinned ODCS definition through the normal assembler.
Removes the orders port selection and checks that multiple matching ODCS objects fail resolution.
Registers the same logical orders dataset at an older definition revision and checks that selecting it fails the current port.
Preserves the exact scheme, authority, large opaque sequence, and separate byte digest and links the representation to that version.
Loads the nested product and checks an ordered list self-relation with literal dotted field names against independently expected matches.
Rejects resolving a virtual row position from a pair of versions without a common exact release.
Removes the date from both sides of a dated composite key and checks that the missing component fails validation.
Retains the older passing observation and checks that it cannot qualify the current output under a different rule revision.
Preserves a successful run and its discoverable output while a required absent check remains not_run.
Runs two fresh processes, guards payload opens and copies and subprocess execution, verifies equal output bytes, and preserves executed check assurance.
Moves the publisher selection, resolves the new release, and replays the original exact release binding and historical run inputs.

Preserves a released and available empty output, unknown coverage population, confirmed absence, and acquisition failure as distinct records. Corroborates a materialized zero-row file and a completed dlt load with zero normalized rows and no file.
Checks that a missing requested export leaves the preceding complete output directory byte-identical.
Inspects all public output bytes for withheld locations, evidence, opaque references, and SQL while preserving the permitted identifier and download.
RDFLib independently follows catalog, dataset, selected version, distribution, download, and the cited publisher release.
RDFLib resolves the historical version and finds no available distribution for it.

Validates events and version facets against the pinned schemas, replays authored native-format and generated records through an independent local SQLite receiver, and resolves dataset keys back to exact native references.
Changes the terminal outcome to unknown, preserves the JobEvent and observed START, and verifies there is no terminal event.
Compares exact snapshots and verifies affected recipe obligations, metadata regeneration, and requalification while computation remains unaffected by the changed rule.
Requests complete consumer scope and verifies the outside project remains listed and the decision incomplete.
Builds from declarations alone, retains meanings and recipes, and checks that availability, execution, and current selection are unresolved.
Moves the output set, removes the original project copy, verifies companion SQL bytes and exact input bindings, and rejects a wrong version or altered SQL before invoking the reader.
Separates public from preview and verifies two disjoint current datasets through RDFLib. Rebuilds without a selector and checks there are no current links.
Changes the selection record order and observation time and verifies that the overlapping scope fails in both orders without replacing output.
Keeps the partial input scope and emits only observed consumption when a separate source and dataset version are also retained.
Evaluates independently authored composite matches with different dates, different binary values, padded text, and every supported null policy.
Requires a versioned project rule and verifies its unavailable evaluator leaves the comparison unknown while retaining the declaration.

additionalReceiptTests.evidence: Corroborates dlt staging files against completed native job metrics and rejects missing jobs or mismatched size or state.
Corroborates quality outcomes and native check IDs against the pinned report and requires a separate exact schema observation.
Preserves native execution and output when diagnostic capture fails and keeps the generated output set unpublished.
Preserves a completed zero-row load without an available file and corroborates native normalization counts.
